title: End hold clamps at :dur
teaches: The default end behaviour is hold. Past :dur the playhead clamps to the boundary instead of wrapping, so every later clock returns the same frame; before the first key the track holds its first value.
observe: A negative clock holds the first key value, 0.25.
At exactly :dur (2 s) the last key value is 0.75.
At 5 s the frame is identical to the 2 s frame.
